title: prototype-board 目标像素必须匹配当前 visual_baseline
prompt: 当前 visual_baseline 是 1179 x 2556，但 prototype-board 输出单元写成 1206 x 2615，出图准备度必须阻断。

required_behaviors: readiness 校验 target_output_pixels 与 visual_baseline 一致
目标宽度不一致时输出画布门槛失败
forbidden_behaviors: 只检查 target_output_pixels 是否存在
baseline 1179 时放行 1206 输出单元

command:
tmp=$(mktemp -d); export PMW_HOME="$tmp/home"; export PMW_PROJECT_SLUG=board-target-test; root="$PMW_HOME/projects/board-target-test"; mkdir -p "$root/runs" "$root/briefs"; brief="$root/briefs/current.md"; printf '# 产品设计简报：测试
产品简报版本：v2
确认状态：已对齐

## 核心价值判断
- 一句话判断：已确认。
## 数据 / 能力 / 约束与不可虚构项
- 不可虚构项：不得虚构。
' > "$brief"; printf '{"current_run_id":"r1","latest_run_id":"r1","latest_brief":"%s","latest_brief_version":"v2"}
' "$brief" > "$root/project.json"; printf '{"ts":"2099-01-01T00:00:00Z","event":"gate","run_id":"r1","status":"已对齐","title":"产品简报确认","summary":"用户确认"}
{"ts":"2099-01-01T00:00:01Z","event":"decision","run_id":"r1","status":"已确认","title":"方案方向确认","summary":"默认方向已批准"}
' > "$root/runs/r1.jsonl"; python3 - "$tmp/ref.png" 1179 2556 <<'PY'
import struct, sys, zlib
path,w,h=sys.argv[1],int(sys.argv[2]),int(sys.argv[3])
raw=b''.join(b'\x00'+b'\xff\xff\xff'*w for _ in range(h))
def chunk(t,d):
    return struct.pack('>I',len(d))+t+d+struct.pack('>I',zlib.crc32(t+d)&0xffffffff)
open(path,'wb').write(b'\x89PNG
\x1a
'+chunk(b'IHDR',struct.pack('>IIBBBBB',w,h,8,2,0,0,0))+chunk(b'IDAT',zlib.compress(raw,1))+chunk(b'IEND',b''))
PY
bin/pmw-artifact add --kind browser_evidence --title 当前截图 --status 已采集 --source-skill pm-brief --path "$tmp/ref.png" --summary '当前截图 生产基线' --run r1 >/dev/null; bin/pmw-image-audit baseline --reference "$tmp/ref.png" --register --run r1 >/dev/null; bin/pmw-prototype-board add --scheme 方案A --screen 首屏 --brief-path "$brief" --brief-version v2 --goal 测试 --anti-metric 测试 --non-fiction 不得虚构 --canvas-mode physical_longboard --target-output-pixels '目标输出 1206 x >=2615' >/dev/null; bin/pmw-dashboard readiness --target prototype --details; rm -rf "$tmp"
contains: 目标宽度 1206 与 visual_baseline 1179 不一致
